title: Traces in line order
description: Trace numbers run strictly one way along the line: the direction is that of the last trace number minus the first (one trace: increasing), and each trace after the first fails when its number does not move strictly that way from the trace before. A stacked 2D line is ordered by CDP ensemble number (SEG-Y rev 2.0, trace header bytes 21-24; binary header trace sorting code 4). The example value is the trace number.
